magtray-2x2.title: Magnetic repair tray 2x2
magtray-2x2.blurb: 9 numbered compartments, one per disassembly step, each with a hidden magnet that grabs M2/M2.5 screws. Seats on any crate as a cap and crates stack on top of it, so a half-done repair can be put away.
magtray-2x2.material: PLA or PETG + 10x2 mm N52 disc magnets
magtray-2x2.print_notes: Upright (foot on the bed), no supports, 0.2 mm layers including the first. Insert a pause at z = 3.0 mm (before the first layer over the pockets, i.e. after the 2.8 mm layer): drop 9 10x2 mm N52 magnets into the pockets, resume. The 0.6 mm ceiling prints on top of them; magnet polarity does not matter.
